scenarios.title: Performance change
scenarios.description: Fahim: Decode below his personal range after short nights; a rest-window step and the open pain follow-up.

scenarios.title: Missing measurement
scenarios.description: Crew B: no sleep reading for last night and an interrupted Decode round; nothing is invented.

scenarios.title: No schedule alternative
scenarios.description: Crew C: short nights, but every evening task is fixed; the system says no valid alternative exists.

scenarios.title: Presentation needing review
scenarios.description: Crew D: a reported symptom opens a review right away, even with a good Decode result.

scenarios.title: Communication delay
scenarios.description: Fahim: a consult summary waits to send and moves through each delivery state with a 24-minute delay.
